mobgrindingutils_fan_sync_dedup.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapMethod on TileEntityFan.getUpdatePacket and @ModifyReturnValue on TileEntityFan.getUpdateTag(Provider). For a fan without NeoForge persistent data or data attachments, the update tag is a function of showRenderBox, the six distances and every slot's item, count and data component patch; the switch keeps those values (floats by their bits, patches as ItemStack.getComponentsPatch() copy-on-write snapshots compared with equals) from the last packet the fan sent. getUpdatePacket returns null without building any tag when the values are unchanged and no different state was handed out since (getUpdateTag watched: the chunk data of a player who starts tracking the fan); otherwise it returns ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this), the packet the mod returns, without the tag the mod builds first and drops, and keeps the values anew. Any other fan runs the mod's own method and is never left out. Exact variant: identical packets are not sent (clients keep their fan's objects); every client's fan state after each broadcast is the original's. Runtime flag mobgrindingutilsFanSyncDedup, shadow mode mobgrindingutilsFanSyncDedup.shadow. Helper bons.furious.patch.mobgrindingutils_coo49.FanSync.
